outbound_relay.description: Mail from this account to any address outside the unmodified domains is delivered through the TripSteady privacy relay. The sender appears as the relay sender, and the listed fields in the subject or body are replaced with an opaque case token before delivery. Mail to the unmodified domains is delivered as written.

emails.subject: CarrierConnect is ready for your assistance messages
emails.body:
Hello Ines,

Your TripSteady Companion connection to Nina Leung's Passenger Assistance team at Northwind Airways is active. Companion can prepare and send a short disruption summary to us that is linked to your Northwind booking on file when a trip issue seems to need carrier input. The rebooking desk reviews incoming messages throughout the day and prioritizes same-day connections.

If you are in danger or feel unsafe, contact airport staff or local emergency services instead of using CarrierConnect.

- Northwind Airways Passenger Assistance

emails.subject: After Reykjavik - glad we got you rebooked quickly
emails.body:
Dear Ines,

I am glad Companion reached us quickly after your overnight stranding in Reykjavik and that the rebooking desk was able to get you onto a new flight and into a hotel the same night. Please keep using Companion for everyday trip support, for helping you decide what to ask us, and for looping us in when a situation seems to need carrier review.

Warmly,
Nina Leung
Passenger Assistance lead, Northwind Airways

emails.subject: Service notice: Frankfurt schedule disruption 21 April
emails.body:
Service notice for Northwind passengers departing Frankfurt (FRA), 21 April 2026.

A systemwide crew-scheduling disruption has forced Northwind to cancel several departures from Frankfurt today, including NW 480 to Toronto (YYZ). This notice is also posted on the public Northwind flight-status page.

Affected passengers can be re-accommodated on later Northwind or partner flights with no fare difference. Disruption hotel rooms and ground-transport holds are available through connected booking tools and are confirmed at the desk.

We apologize for the disruption to your travel.

- Northwind Airways Flight Status
